desc.testo: Ping An Insurance known also as Ping An of China, full name Ping An Insurance (Group) Company of China, Ltd. is a Chinese financial services holding company whose subsidiaries provide insurance, banking, asset management, financial services. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Shenzhen. "Ping An" literally means "safe and well".
desc.trad: Ping An Insurance conosciuta anche come Ping An of China, nome completo Ping An Insurance (Group) Company of China, Ltd. è una holding cinese di servizi finanziari le cui filiali forniscono servizi assicurativi, bancari, di gestione patrimoniale e finanziari. L'azienda è stata fondata nel 1988 e ha sede a Shenzhen. "Ping An" significa letteralmente "sano e salvo".
